title: my_boss_paid_my_rent
display_title: My boss quietly paid my rent for six months — then I found out why
beats: My boss (41M) has been secretly paying my rent for six months, and I never told him I noticed.
It started when I mentioned, once, in passing, that I was three days from eviction.
The next month my landlord said my balance was zero and wouldn't say why.
I checked the account transfer name for fun. It was his LLC, the one that does 'consulting.'
I kept showing up, working late, saying nothing, because the second I said thank you, it would become real and I'd owe him something I couldn't name.
Last week his wife called HR asking why he'd moved money out every month since March.
I still haven't said a word. Was I wrong to let it stay quiet?
